checks.evidence: Frozen HEAD/base is 8a25bd217362b3143ff1045b110b3fc9c9c6f7fc; 113 staged files are bound below. Staged src/, tests/ and .github/ deltas are empty. The only non-doc delta is seven failure-print lines in scripts/run-functional-completion-smoke.ps1. Reviewed working file identities matched the frozen index.

All 144 inventory entries match their Git text-normalized stage-zero blob OIDs and captured filesystem SHA256 values. The inventory explicitly distinguishes captured byte hashes from Git text normalization. Inventory self and this later review receipt are excluded from recursive inventory binding.

TRX counters were parsed as recorded artifacts, not re-executed. Narrative distinguishes causal red/green regressions, original failed runs, focused validation, final validation, and withdrawn claims. No assertions or golden corpus were rewritten in D.

PR116 exact head 508ba21e112d4e0c3097fdde89bb569ef967948a had successful CI 37143736148 and Security 37143736107. Postmerge main 8a25bd217362b3143ff1045b110b3fc9c9c6f7fc CI 37145182291 failed at PERF_visual_lifetime_and_public_commands with 'Background did not progress', after twelve functional scenarios passed. Core/Data and WPF profile steps passed; later CI steps were skipped. Report, ledger and worklog disclose that distinct failure. The failure phase was not present in that runner's captured output, and no causal link to the Asus callback observations is asserted.

checks.evidence: Compared the four declared versioned log copies against retained private originals and recorded hashes. All original and versioned hashes matched their receipt. Differences were only trailing spaces/tabs: D-cli-selftest.log six lines, D-gates-corrected.log 49, D-gates-final-C.log 49, D-gates-first.log 48. Other line-content changes were zero; original logs remain preserved.

Report distinguishes the noninteractive diagnostic measurement from three short legitimate Interactive/Limited desktop attempts. Each later attempt has one valid foreground/desktop environment sample but still fails scan-one visual timeout and completes neither environment nor stability qualification. Captured TextEditor callbacks and CPU/allocation figures are observations, not an installed-binary-matched cause. No budget/priority/protection relaxation or product fix is inferred. Synthetic catalog/delta/load and fault-injection evidence is labelled finite/local, with no live, sustained stability, real Win7 hardware or real SMB acceptance claim.

The report describes the recorded bounded 100000-row synthetic fixture, forty committed 500-row pages, 24 public scans and payment previews, one validated reopened backup, and per-fixture lane peak one. It separates measured scan/payment/Input latencies and sampled memory from performance acceptance, native-copy interval from operation overlap, and fixture evidence from live sales/restore readiness. Recorded business integrity and no-sale/output assertions retain their original scope.

Direction and domain mappings are consistent with the reviewed source-backed contract matrix. Supported live scenarios remain blocked by fresh linked-project readiness/artifacts; article-v1 excludes standalone POS reference CRUD origin, Admin offline-outbox origin and mobile ledger/History domains where unsupported. Mobile stock consumption and price propagation remain in scope. No mobile reactivation UI is inferred from deletedAt-null mapping. Sales/restore readiness remains separate. Existing owner-approved historical deferrals remain intact; no new deferral is invented.

Three roadmap/ledger updates and worklog preserve historical ownership and scope while recording actual implementation and failures. Final D merge, final-main checkout/checks, ReleasePack and downloaded-pack verification are explicitly pending in a future postmerge machine receipt rather than self-embedded SHA claims. This receipt does not verify that future delivery.
